sentences.en: What is the best way to get there?
sentences.ar: ما أفضل وسيلة للوصول إلى هناك؟

sentences.en: The metro is usually convenient.
Where is the nearest metro station?
I need a ticket for one trip.
Can I pay with my phone?
Which line should I take?
Take the green line north.
How many stops are left?
We need to change trains.
Get off at the next station.
The train is running late.
Let us check the timetable.
This platform is very crowded.
Please stand behind the yellow line.
Is this seat taken?
You can sit here.
I missed my bus this morning.
When does the next bus arrive?
The bus comes every fifteen minutes.
sentences.ar: تصل الحافلة كل خمس عشرة دقيقة.

sentences.en: Could you call a taxi for me?
sentences.ar: هل يمكنك طلب سيارة أجرة لي؟

sentences.en: Please take me to the city center.
sentences.ar: أوصلني إلى وسط المدينة من فضلك.

sentences.en: How long will the journey take?
There is heavy traffic ahead.
Could you use another route?
Please stop near the entrance.
I will send you the location.
The driver is two minutes away.
I am waiting outside the building.
The ride was comfortable.
Is parking free here?
You need to pay at the machine.
I forgot where I parked.
Let us take a picture of the level.
We arrived right on time.

sections.heading: A new situation
paragraphs: Dina was learning how to handle getting around in everyday English. The goal was to communicate clearly and politely. Dina practiced “What is the best way to get there?” A useful phrase was “The metro is usually convenient.” A useful phrase was “Where is the nearest metro station?” They repeated it to remember the meaning. Dina practiced “I need a ticket for one trip.” A useful phrase was “Can I pay with my phone?” A useful phrase was “Which line should I take?” They repeated it to remember the meaning.
